Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model.interfaces

Interface ISudoku

All Known Implementing Classes:
Sudoku
public interface ISudoku
Defines the contract for the Sudoku game logic on a 6x6 board. Any class implementing this interface is responsible for managing board generation, move validation, cell updates, hint support, and game state verification. The board uses a HashMap with keys in "row,col" format and integer values from 1 to 6.

  • Method Details

    • generateBoard

      void generateBoard()
      Generates a new valid and solvable 6x6 Sudoku puzzle. Implementations must ensure the generated board has a unique solution and that at least 2 cells per 2x3 block are pre-filled.

    • isValidMove

      boolean isValidMove(int row, int col, int value)
      Checks if placing a value at the given position is valid. Validates the value against the corresponding row, column, and 2x3 block on the current player board.
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the target cell (0â€“5).
      col - the column index of the target cell (0â€“5).
      value - the value to validate (1â€“6).
      Returns:
      true if the move does not cause any conflict, false otherwise.

    • getBoard

      HashMap<String,Integer> getBoard()
      Returns the current state of the player's puzzle board. Only cells that have been filled (pre-filled or placed by the player) are included in the returned map.
      Returns:
      a HashMap mapping cell coordinates in "row,col" format to their current integer values.

    • updateCellValue

      void updateCellValue(int row, int col, int value)
      Directly updates the value of a specific cell on the player's board. This method does not perform validation. Use validateAndPlace(java.lang.String, int) for player input that requires correctness checking.
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the target cell (0â€“5).
      col - the column index of the target cell (0â€“5).
      value - the new value to assign to the cell (1â€“6).

    • validateAndPlace

      boolean validateAndPlace(String coordinate, int value)
      Validates a player's input against the solution and places it if correct. The value is placed on the board only if it matches the expected solution value and does not violate any Sudoku rule.
      Parameters:
      coordinate - the target cell coordinate in "row,col" format.
      value - the value the player wants to place (1â€“6).
      Returns:
      true if the value was correctly placed on the board, false if it does not match the solution or breaks a rule.

    • getHelpValue

      int getHelpValue(String coordinate)
      Returns the correct solution value for a given cell. Used by the hint system to reveal the expected value at a specific position without exposing the full solution.
      Parameters:
      coordinate - the cell coordinate in "row,col" format.
      Returns:
      the correct integer value for that cell (1â€“6).

    • isGameFinished

      boolean isGameFinished()
      Checks whether the game has been completed successfully. The game is considered finished when all 36 cells are filled and the player's board matches the solution exactly.
      Returns:
      true if the board is complete and correct, false otherwise.

    • getFullSolution

      HashMap<String,Integer> getFullSolution()
      Returns the complete solution map of the current puzzle. Contains all 36 cells with their correct values. Should be used carefully to avoid exposing the solution to the player.
      Returns:
      a HashMap with all cell coordinates in "row,col" format mapped to their correct solution values.

    • pushMove

      void pushMove(String coordinate)
      Records a player move by pushing a cell coordinate onto the history stack. Used to support undo functionality by keeping track of the order in which cells were filled.
      Parameters:
      coordinate - the cell coordinate in "row,col" format to record.

    • popMove

      String popMove()
      Removes and returns the last recorded move from the history stack. Used to undo the player's most recent move. Returns null if no moves have been recorded yet.
      Returns:
      the last move coordinate in "row,col" format, or null if the history is empty.
